We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Or carbon NMR to see methyl carbons. The task is to count CH3 groups.

We need to get the sample's compound. The system likely has a sample loaded. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed). It will return spectra as string. Then we can analyze peaks: methyl protons appear around 0.9 ppm (singlet, doublet, etc). But we need to count distinct CH3 groups. Could also use carbon NMR to see methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Might need HSQC to correlate.

Simplify: Use proton NMR first.
